{{Top}}
{{Image}}
A '''museum''' was a building that housed exhibits which provided information about certain topics, such as art, history, and extinct animals.

Museums could be dedicated to the study of an entire eras, such as the [[Museum of the Old Republic]], which preserved items and culture of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It was there that [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] first learned the name of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="quest">[[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]]</ref>

The [[Korsin Museum]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] contained objects from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s past.<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref> [[Varner Hilts]] later had a museum on Kesh, although its contents were destroyed in [[3000 BBY]] by pillagers.<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets]]''</ref>

[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], boasted at least three museums: the [[Coruscant Museum/Legends|Coruscant Museum]],<ref name="threat">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> the [[Coruscant Museum of Galactic Cultures]]<ref name="campaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the [[Coruscant Xenozoology Museum]].<ref name="medstar">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
